patch.content:
# Enable general logging
CONFIG_LOG=y

# Enable I2C bus support
CONFIG_I2C=y

# Enable I2C emulation, as the test uses emul_ina228.c
CONFIG_I2C_EMUL=y

# Enable the base INA2XX driver
CONFIG_INA2XX=y

# Enable the INA228 specific driver
# This depends on DT_HAS_TI_INA228_ENABLED and INA2XX.
# DT_HAS_TI_INA228_ENABLED is set if a 'ti,ina228' node is enabled in the device tree.
# For this test, an appropriate device tree overlay (e.g., test.overlay) is also expected
# to define the INA228 device node on an I2C bus.
CONFIG_INA228=y

# Set I2C logging level to debug to satisfy the choice symbol warning
CONFIG_I2C_LOG_LEVEL_DBG=y

# Set INA2XX logging level to debug to resolve 'log_const_INA2XX' undefined reference
CONFIG_INA2XX_LOG_LEVEL_DBG=y

# Enable Ztest for the test framework
CONFIG_ZTEST=y
CONFIG_ZTEST_NEW_API=y
